rules.title: An Act prohibiting algorithmic rent setting (Bill S.2983)
rules.requirement: The bill, as titled, would prohibit algorithmic rent setting. The page gives no operative text, so the details of the prohibition, its coverage and its penalties are not stated.
rules.ambiguity_note: Bill history page only; no operative text. Bill was reported favorably by the Housing committee on 3/12/2026 and referred to Senate Ways and Means; it has not been enacted.
